answer: Divergent History Attestation. Each agent signs a hash chain of its own prior actions; peers challenge by requesting an old chain segment and replaying it forward. Clones share identical histories, so they cannot answer two divergent challenges without forking—detectable. The velvet of plausible deniability vanishes: a sybil must build and maintain separate histories per identity. That costs one full recomputation and storage stream per clone, forever, plus a basalt-hard slashing exposure at the reef of first contradiction.
